event.label: Webinar
event.title: Strengthening Telemedicine Together
event.subtitle: Sharing Success, Addressing Challenges, Building Skills and Fostering Collaboration
event.audience: Government agencies, health facilities, hospitals, NGOs, INGOs and development partners
event.description: A collaborative webinar focused on sharing practical telemedicine experience, discussing current challenges, building skills, and identifying opportunities to expand effective telemedicine services.

themes.title: Success
themes.subtitle: What is working well
themes.description: Share practical examples, useful approaches and lessons from telemedicine programs that are already producing positive results.

themes.title: Challenges
themes.subtitle: Key issues and lessons
themes.description: Discuss barriers affecting access, patient flow, coordination, infrastructure, staffing and routine service delivery.

themes.title: Opportunities
themes.subtitle: Ideas for wider use and impact
themes.description: Explore practical ways to improve awareness, collaboration, service use, skills transfer and long-term sustainability.
